text.title: Minimum Product Frameworks Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree on observable signals to apply / skip / route-elsewhere. Each leaf references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml. Market-condition to framework mapping with rationale for each selection.

conclusion.verdict: re-pick is premature; honour existing DR until trigger fires
